evidence.explanation: CRAG tests diverse factual questions across domains and question types. Its reported industry-system performance falls well short of broadly reliable query answering; the remaining percentage should not automatically be treated as a hallucination rate.

The winning task scores were 28.40%, 42.7% and 47.8%, showing that broad RAG challenge performance remained incomplete shortly before the deadline. These are competition scores, not percentages of hallucinated answers.

Acurai announced a hallucination-free service before the deadline. The stated validation concerned RAGTruth, so the announcement is material counterevidence but does not establish reliable answering across Marcus's broader scope.

The later paper reports a sample of 37 and limits its finding to factual input passages and small contexts. This clarifies why the company's result does not demonstrate the broad capability at issue; it is not treated as an August outcome.
